method: Choose 10 sub-industries uniformly from those with at least 5 training-eligible stocks, then choose 5 stocks without replacement per selected sub-industry. Eligibility uses training prices only; no correlation or later-period results used in sampling.
price_source: Cached adjusted prices from the preceding full-universe screen, same date window.
ordering: Eligible industry names sorted before sampling; sampled industries sorted before member draws; peers sorted by Yahoo ticker; final universe sorted by Yahoo ticker.
